# scamp_network (Resource)

Manages a network in SCAMP. Use type='private' for isolated networks, type='public' with router_uuid for internet-connected networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A private network is isolated: only the VMs you attach to it can talk over it.
resource "scamp_network" "internal" {
  name = "internal"
  type = "private"
  cidr = "10.77.20.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Type of network: 'private' (isolated) or 'public' (attached to router, requires router_uuid).

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) CIDR block for the network (e.g., 10.50.0.0/24). Auto-generated if not provided.
- `description` (String) Description of the network.
- `name` (String) Name of the network (1-64 characters). Auto-generated if not provided.
- `router_uuid` (String) UUID of the router to attach this network to. Required when type='public'.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags to assign to the network as key-value pairs.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the network was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the network.
- `status` (String) Current status of the network (provision_queued, active, etc.).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import scamp_network.internal 3e15b384-5276-4385-ae7d-5746a246794d
```
